title: Regioselective green synthesis of some novel indole-substituted 1H-benzo[f]chromenes via one-pot three-component reactions in water–ethanol media
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17815-17824
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02182D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amirhossein Khanmohammadi, Abolfazl Olyaei, Mahdieh Sadeghpour
An efficient procedure for the regioselective green synthesis of novel indole-substituted chromenes was developed. The domino reaction involves piperidine-catalyzed Knoevenagel condensation, Michael addition, and intramolecular heteroannulation.
